summary: Himax Technologies, Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 7, 2026, announcing a cash dividend of 25.2 cents per ADS (12.6 cents per ordinary share) for FY2025. The dividend is payable on July 10, 2026 to shareholders of record as of June 30, 2026, with the ADS book closed from June 23 to June 30. The company declared a 100% payout ratio of last year's profit, citing a healthy balance sheet and positive cashflow outlook. CEO Jordan Wu highlighted the consistency of the dividend policy since IPO in 2006. This filing reports a routine dividend declaration, a capital return to shareholders, not a special situation event.
